description: Presidential Secretariate - Appointed Hon. Vadivelu Suresh Member of Parliament as the State Minister of Labour with Effect from 21st August 2024
categorisation: This gazette content names a specific individual (Honourable Vadivelu Suresh, Member of Parliament) and specifies his appointment to a particular ministerial position (State Minister of Labour), including the effective date. This constitutes both the "who" (government person) and "what" (specific government position), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
